label: Compare inclusive actual-order explanation with contained contingent bruteness
summary: See docs/notes/explanatory-adequacy-750.md#restricted-bruteness-local-success-versus-exact-order-explanation-2026-11-25. Draft PR-1968 continues PR-1872/1908/1910/1927/1933. Distinguishes local derivative, structural, generic-role and inclusive actuality explananda. Under the proposed scope principle, the latter cannot be fully answered while its included B lacks an adequate reason; does not imply universal existential coverage. Two populated finite worlds retain one brute contingent base each, all derivative reason assignments, fixed identities, invariant constraints and a correct resident-observer identity decoder. Role-only observations cannot distinguish occupants uniformly; conditioning on the actual essentially dependent D0 screens off its base-absence world. Finite assignments and rational probability samples checked with a standalone Python diagnostic, not a Lean certificate. A necessary exemption can be directly warranted without falling within the being-level contingent PSR; even a contingent rule fact is not automatically a being. Positive priority, conditional essence, necessary role occupancy and intrinsic self-intelligibility have distinct explanatory scopes. The inspected firstMoverNecessaryByEsseCause proof uses B2 only at its selected f; a mover-scoped strength restriction is proposed, not registered or checked for novelty. Retain BX1/BX2 and actual firstness/priority/existence premises. A nonnecessitating actual reason may explain the recipient without uniquely determining an act; scope, operative content and actual production remain separate. No premise established, no new formal edge or source claim. Prior accepted E/D and practical-content assessments remain intact. Continuation at 2f4005e1a1129f8609967a683bee97a570565b0a, docs/notes/explanatory-adequacy-750.md#restricted-bruteness-intrinsic-reason-actual-application-and-fundamentality-2026-11-25: natureModel's world-free identity condition plus existing global Sound entails existence at every represented world, hence B6 on the contingency witness; proposed proof only, not Lean elaborated or novelty-checked. Original selfNature countermodel does not assert global Sound; target-existence gating restores Sound while preserving the selected-world own-nature token and B2 failure, without warrant for its adequacy. In any sound reason model a specific actual reason for an absent-at-an-accessible-world bearer cannot persist there. Necessity of content alone need not give that edge transport. Five matched fact-level assignments preserve all truth profiles and distinguish a borrowed cycle, unexplained primitive application, nonnecessitating nature reason and represented contingent-fact coverage. Standalone finite diagnostic passed. Positive nonreceipt licenses and ontic reasons remain distinct. A proposed external-reason availability weakening of BX1 retains PSR and BX2 and is structurally weaker by the existing conserved/selfAndOccasion control; combined mover-scoping is pending canonical preflight. No new verified edge or warrant status; preserve the prior judgment. Continuation at 70d1370da0cdd3ef5896221e213aa71aa2521c2e: docs/notes/explanatory-adequacy-750.md#restricted-bruteness-what-limits-an-unreceived-act-2026-11-25 isolates contingency→qualitative limitation and limitation→reception (#1881), proposes independent ceiling/grade/conditional-nature diagnostics, tests four populated matched overlays and four fixed-input probes, and identifies the actual determinant versus primitive typed-act distinction. All finite checks ran successfully in standalone Python; structural surrogates do not certify metaphysical possibility or the calibration to limited esse. A whole-first mode cannot supply its own whole's existence in the same asymmetric grounding relation if its existence depends on that whole. Even a successful limitation-to-reception principle leaves the qualitatively unrestricted but contingently actual rival unless C→L or a separate modal grounding bridge holds. Existing Route C uses B6 only on its selected f; localized R1/B6 application is a proposed strength restriction, not a new formal result. Horizontal causal-perfection witness plan keeps possession and productive power distinct. No existing warrant or status changed. Continuation of the owner's ten-part single-brute comparison at integration baseline 7e64ec6b9c5203b84975dac030ae6ce04e824e48: the linked note now distinguishes actual complete local derivative explanations from inclusive and ancestral completeness, defends the strongest receipt/nonreceipt stopping criterion while separating its warrant from an ontic reason, and checks necessary occupancy plus same-B absence to a different occupant without recombination. A core Lean diagnostic elaborates with zero axioms; it is not a registered Comparator/NanoDa result. A finite same-B extension of Contained false preserves the derivative structure while activating its already present necessary background; an explicit act-fact extension retains an exercise input. Both are structural diagnostics, not adequate-production proofs or a model of the single-concrete-root rival. The six-worldview note is reconciled. PSR/B2/C2, source adequacy and the older limitation/absence bridges remain open; no formal graph change.
blocker: No unconditional refutation of the principled primitive follows from the granted bundle. Need warrant that the selected positive nonreceipt feature licenses absence of every adequate existential reason, or warrant for ancestral completeness plus a positive alternative meeting that same scope. For the necessary-source alternative, provide substantive intrinsic existential intelligibility and actual nonnecessitating production of the same target; an assigned edge, modal presence or primitive exercise alone does not do so. The earlier #1881 C-to-L/L-to-R bridges, same-mover R1/B6 and BX1/BX2 applications and foundational-absence-warrant §12 remain unresolved at their prior scopes. Necessary occupancy, unique role or reliable cognition by themselves do not close them.

current_assessment.scope: Single brute foundation: actual derivative completeness, inclusive and ancestral explanation, role-based exemptions, self-application and a matched necessary-source comparison
current_assessment.assessment: The strongest restricted rival may retain actual, locally complete derivative explanations and principled restrictions while leaving B primitive. Its inclusive actual-existence account is incomplete for a target expressly covering B; extending the deficit to each derivative requires a defended ancestral-completeness standard. No contradiction, universal epistemic defeat, unstable laws or further simultaneous brute exception follows. Necessary role occupancy plus this B's accessible absence entails a different occupant in that same world; uniqueness is compatible with substitution and the alternative need not itself be contingent or brute. A receipt/nonreceipt criterion has positive scope-based warrant for a causal stop but does not automatically license the absence of every adequate existential reason. Evidence for its acceptance is distinct from an ontic ground of B. The same-B structural control improves contingent-being reason coverage only by adding an admitted source edge from an already present necessary background; it neither proves adequacy nor represents a sole-concrete-root rival. A separate exercise-fact extension retains an input under the displayed deterministic rules. An intrinsically intelligible necessary source with adequate actual production could answer more of the same target; modal necessity alone and primitive exercise receive no exemption from the common scope standard. Retain moderate preference for adequate existential intelligibility E and suspension about universal determining D; no established PSR, B2/C2 discharge, actual-source identification or personal-over-impersonal ranking.
current_assessment.next_test: For the proposed real foundation, identify its positive nonreceipt feature and test whether it licenses only no supplier or also no adequate existential reason of any kind. For the necessary-source competitor, supply intrinsic existence-conveying content and a warranted actual nonnecessitating relation to the same B or identity-compatible derivatives, then state whether the claim covers its act fact. Reopen on discriminating evidence or a conflict with the rival's own uniform standard; another fixed-law assignment or primitive count adds no discrimination. Preserve the earlier limitation/reception and unrestricted-bearer reopening conditions, same-mover conditions and #1933 operative-content/channel blockers.
